description: Approved least-privilege set for the Security Oak reader app. Single source of truth for setup, the health check module, and the documentation. Role IDs are resolved at runtime by permission value; expectedRoleId, when set, is asserted against the resolved ID.

permissions.reason: Users, groups, devices, applications, service principals, licenses, and delegated permission grants.
Conditional Access, security defaults, authorization, and authentication method policies.
Directory role assignments and eligibility, including the reader app's own roles.
Sign-in activity for stale accounts and license use, and the reader app's own sign-ins.
Users flagged at risk by Microsoft Entra ID Protection.
Risk detections behind risky users.
Intune managed devices, compliance state, and encryption.
SharePoint and OneDrive external sharing settings.
Microsoft Secure Score and improvement actions.
Usage reports for sharing activity and license use.
Access reviews, reviewers, decisions, and settings, for reviewing standing access.
Attack simulation training campaigns and results.
Local administrator (LAPS) credential metadata managed by Intune, excluding the password itself.
Intune-managed app properties, assignments, and protection policies.
Intune device configuration profiles and their assignment status.
Intune role-based access control role definitions and assignments.
Intune PowerShell and remediation scripts and their assignments.
Intune enrollment and device configuration service settings.
Verified domains, DNS records used for verification, and federation configuration.
Tenant organization information, including verified domains and directory settings Teams depends on.
Privileged Identity Management policies for Microsoft Entra directory role assignments.
Microsoft 365 Defender and Purview security alerts.
Microsoft 365 Defender security incidents, correlated from alerts.
Advanced hunting with a fixed set of read-only KQL queries. Advanced hunting is called through a POST; this is a logged, documented read-only exception.
Registered authentication methods per user, for MFA and passwordless coverage checks.
Delegated and application permission grant policies, to review consent governance.
Device configuration policy read access, complementing Intune configuration profiles.
BitLocker recovery key metadata only (key IDs and timestamps), never the recovery key itself.
Microsoft 365 service health status and incidents.
Microsoft 365 message center announcements and advisories.
eDiscovery cases, holds, and search configuration in Purview.
Microsoft 365 Backup protection policies and job status.
Microsoft 365 Backup service configuration.
Tenant-level usage report display settings, which affect the sharing and licensing report output.
Privileged Identity Management policies for group-based role assignments.
App-only Exchange Online PowerShell. Only Get cmdlets are used; the Global Reader role limits it to reading.
Defender for Endpoint device inventory, onboarding health, sensor state and exposure level.
Vulnerability and exposed-device counts from Defender Vulnerability Management.
Security recommendations from Defender Vulnerability Management.
Software inventory, end-of-support and vulnerable software.
Exposure score and device secure score.
App-only Security and Compliance PowerShell (Connect-IPPSSession). Only Get cmdlets are used; the Global Reader role limits it to reading. Separate from the Office 365 Exchange Online grant.

directoryRoles.name: Global Reader
directoryRoles.reason: Read-only role that scopes Exchange.ManageAsApp and covers admin-center settings not exposed by Graph permissions.

azureRoles.name: Reader
azureRoles.reason: Informational. Read Azure resources and configuration. Not checked or assigned by setup. Azure Policy compliance uses one fixed POST (policyStates latest summarize), a logged, documented read-only exception.

azureRoles.name: Security Reader
azureRoles.reason: Informational. Read Microsoft Defender for Cloud recommendations and alerts. Not checked or assigned by setup.
